title: Lord of Earth
text: For a while, Father dove down… and then the water’s surface began to glow.
“Pah!”
Before long, Father surfaced, face breaking through the water.
“Naofumi-san. The surface glowed just now, did something happen?”

“Yeah, there’s some kind of huge hole at the bottom of the lake, or maybe more like an entrance to another dimension. There’s a fish and meat symbol above it, and it looks like there’s another boss waiting beyond it.”
“A boss? What kind of monster was it?”
“Hmm… some kind of horned whale-looking monster. Named Lord of the Sea, I think. Underwater, of course. Pretty spacious special field.”
Ren flinched, twitching visibly.
“Ren-san, why are you flinching?”
“M-me, flinching? Hmph! I don’t know what you’re talking about.”

Itsuki, Father, and I stared at Ren in silence. Naturally, splitting the lake open wasn’t an option, I say. Just as we’d verified inside the dungeon, Father turning into a Peckul remained the fitting mechanism for this.
“Anyway, if I go into the water my cheek pouches puff up and I can’t move properly, and Motoyasu-san’s out too, so Ren-san. Please go fight together with Naofumi-san.”
“Naofumi, lure that boss over here.”
“I tried using skills to draw it out, or getting close to check things out, but the moment you try to leave the field, it stops chasing right away.”

Impressive, Father — already thoroughly tested in advance. Come to think of it, Father was always the type to verify all sorts of things. As a result, this turned out to be excellent leverage for cornering Ren.
“Then dive with Motoyasu and finish it in one breath.”
“Stab, stab, indeed!”
Boss-hunting together with Father, I say.
“Ren-san, you’re being stubborn. Just go already!”
“N-no! Even I can’t contribute to combat if I’m focused on magic!”
“If you just grab onto me and hold your sword out in front, I’ll charge in and attack for you, you know?”

Oh ho, so Father had already thought of a way to make use of Ren even as dead weight in combat. In other words, Ren would simply hold onto the sword while Father rushed past, delivering attacks on his behalf, I say.
“If you’re that scared about running out of breath, why not just wear the costume that boss dropped earlier? It practically screamed ‘use me,’ didn’t it?”
Father produced a Pengu costume right then and there. This costume was modeled after a Peckul.
“…Now that you mention it, that’s true. By the way, even in this form, are we still classified as monsters? It seems to have a race-change effect.”
“I wonder about that.”
“I’ll try it on, I say!”
The moment I took the costume from Father, its size adjusted. It looked like it would fit, so I put it on. And so, I ended up wearing a penguin-shaped hood.
“Peckul Usaunny Motoyasu, reporting for duty!”
“Go with that! Motoyasu!”
“Ren-san’s stubborn refusal to enter the water is, in a way, admirable. By the way, if I equip this, would it cancel out my cheek pouch swelling?”

Itsuki held out a hand asking for it, so I took off the hood and handed it over. Itsuki put it on and went straight into the water, but just as expected, the cheek pouches puffed up immediately and he came right back out.
“…No good. It seems the original race takes priority — the race-change effect doesn’t apply.”
“So for Itsuki, floating takes priority instead? Or rather, it just has no effect at all?”
“Seems like a purely cosmetic accessory with no functional effect, I say.”
It appeared to be nothing more than a Peckul-shaped hood.
For some reason, Itsuki placed the hood — now transformed from the Pengu costume — onto Ren’s head.
“Ah…”
The eyes on the hood began to glow. Something different was clearly happening compared to when Itsuki or I wore it.
“Seems like some kind of effect is triggering.”
“T-there’s no such effect!”
“Don’t lie. The glowing eyes on that head make it pretty obvious, don’t they?”
“Why did you even put it on Ren in the first place?”
“Just testing things, really. It seems Motoyasu-san and I get no effect, but Ren-san seems to activate an effect when equipping it in his fairy form.”
Ren clicked his tongue, just loud enough for the rest of us to hear.
“What is this?! It’s like fate itself is telling me to dive together with Naofumi!”
“That’s a bit of an edgy way to put it… I wonder if it’s reacting to water magic aptitude or something?”
“What’s suspicious is that fish and meat symbol we saw when entering the field. Maybe it’s an instruction meaning we should fight as Peckul and Inult.”
“Guh…”
“Which would mean…”
Ren strode off toward the path leading to the next floor, the one he’d had his attention on, to check it out.
“Over there, on what looks like the path to the next floor, there’s a carrot and a nut symbol. Seems like the mechanic was designed to split us up for separate challenges.”
“Why this split?! Carrots and fish would’ve been fine! Think about nutritional balance!”
Ren shouted up at the sky. The dungeon echoed with it. The carrot was surely meant to represent the rabbit — me, in other words.
“Weapon-wise, considering there’s a harpoon and other underwater-suited gear, Motoyasu-san’s the better fit, honestly.”
“Motoyasu-kun as a Peckul does seem to match well with the weapons.”
“Things never go the way you want, do they.”
“Guh…”
“Now, now… Ren, don’t be so reluctant, let’s go.”
And so, with Father carrying him on his back, Ren reluctantly submerged into the lake.
“Well then, Motoyasu-san. Let’s go defeat our assigned boss and come back too.”
“I would’ve preferred pairing with Father over Itsuki, but it can’t be helped, I say.”

And so, advancing into the next room together with Itsuki, out came a monster that looked like a dragon made of glowing red magma — Lord of Earth. The heat was so intense it felt like my fur was scorching.
“The battle itself looks like it’ll be over quickly.”
“GROOOAAAAAAAAAAAH!”

In response to Itsuki’s words, Lord of Earth roared and stomped the ground, unleashing Earth Ignition at us. Ho… I happen to know an equivalent skill myself, so facing this opponent stirred something in me, I say.
“Take this — Earth Ignition Ⅹ, I say!”
My unleashed Earth Ignition sent Lord of Earth flying up into the air.
“ROOOOAAAAH—!?”
Just from that alone, it was clear the thing was finished.
“Defeating it with just Motoyasu-san alone wouldn’t be very interesting, would it. Just to be safe, even though it’s already dead — Eagle Piercing Shot Ⅹ!”
Thwack! Itsuki landed the follow-up strike, and Lord of Earth shattered, dissolving into shadow before disappearing. What remained were model parts.
“Honestly… once your weapon’s upgraded and your level’s high enough, this becomes a total cakewalk.”
“Fighting alongside Itsuki really does drain all the fun out of it, I say.”
“Excuse me? …Well, whatever, fine. Given the situation, it seems logical that I’d get some effect from wearing a Rabbit costume — I wonder what would happen in that case.”
“Shall we try it, then?”
I pulled out a Rabbit costume for him. In response, Itsuki produced a Squirrel costume. Apparently he wanted me to wear it — please, spare me that.
“Well, let’s save the testing for later. Let’s grab this model and regroup with the others… although, how should I put this…”

Itsuki looked around at our surroundings, so I checked as well — it really was quite a spacious field. Looked like a volcanic zone. Come to think of it, there was talk of a place like this appearing in the wave battles detected by the Dragon Hourglass, out beyond human settlements, that a certain great Filolial-sama supposedly handled. I remembered being entrusted with tackling one myself back in the very first world, under Father’s orders.
“We’ve beaten our boss too, so let’s regroup for now.”
“Indeed.”
And so, with that, we made our way straight back to the underground lake.
